content:
Anya: Hey — noticed the SLO runbook has a couple of 404s when I clicked the 'incident retros' link. Seen on /docs/runbooks/slo. Anyone own that page?
Sam: @Anya that's my area, I think a few links broke after the nav reorg. Can you paste the broken link(s)?
Anya: Sure — footer link goes to /docs/incidents/retros but that currently 404s. Sidebar 'Postmortems' also points to a dead page.
Sam: Got it. I can open a quick PR to add redirects and fix the sidebar/frontmatter. ETA ~2h.
Lucy: @Sam if you're editing the sidebar can you also add the new oncall runbook under "Oncall -> Runbooks"? Saves another PR.
Sam: Yep will add it. Drafting PR now. (I'll include a stable slug suggestion.)
Kevin: Suggestion: instead of yeared indices, add a stable /docs/incidents/retros slug that redirects to the latest index. Means links from other pages don't break on yearly updates.
Sam: Agreed — adding a Netlify redirect rule for that. Will also update runbook links to use the stable slug.
Matt: After merge can someone trigger the link check for /docs/runbooks/*? I can spot-check but automated sweep is better.
docs-bot: Scheduled: link-check for /docs/runbooks/* at 2026-05-05T15:10:00Z. Results will post to this thread.
Sam: PR opened as draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3124 (fix/redirects-runbook-404s). Leaving in draft until CI & link-check.
docs-bot: Link check complete: 2 broken links fixed, 1 external timeout warning. Details: https://ci.internal/linkchecks/1245
Sam: CI passed, removed draft, merging now. Added redirect from /docs/incidents/retros -> /docs/incidents/retros/2026-index and created stable slug /docs/incidents/retros/latest.
Anya: Verified prod after merge — links look good from my side :thumbsup:
Kevin: Nice, thanks. Small doc ops win.
Lucy: Marking the runbook owner in the docs metadata would help next time — @Sam pls add yourself to frontmatter.
Sam: Will add owner field and a one-liner in the runbook. Thanks for the catch everyone.
